At Duffield Chiropractic Clinic in Derby we aim to look after you whether your problem is pain, improving posture, or increasing your performance. At our clinic we treat back pain, neck pain, sciatica and many more conditions. Many of these come on through a rather trivial injury, or jsut 'come out of nowhere'. We set up this channel to help people learn more to prevent these issues from coming back.

The more you learn ways to take care of your spine and health, the better you can become!

For more information please see our website www.duffieldchiropractic.co.uk
